name: qr-inventory-backend
description: REST API Backend for QR Inventory Management System

scripts.dev:sqlite: copy /Y prisma\schema.sqlite.prisma prisma\schema.prisma && cross-env DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" npx prisma db push --skip-generate && cross-env DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts && cross-env DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" nodemon --watch src --exec ts-node src/index.ts
scripts.dev:postgres: copy /Y prisma\schema.postgres.prisma prisma\schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts && nodemon --watch src --exec ts-node src/index.ts
scripts.import:excel: copy /Y prisma\schema.sqlite.prisma prisma\schema.prisma && cross-env DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" npx prisma db push && cross-env DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" node scripts/seed_from_coficab_excel.js
